description: By Aly Kleidon | Oct 22, 2025TRAVERSE CITY — Grand Traverse and Benzie counties are joining Leelanau’s effort to expand child care in northwestern Michigan following a $400,000 grant awarded by the state in September.The Leelanau Early Childhood Development Commission announced it received the funding to increase the reach of the Infant and Toddler Child Care Start-Up Expansion program, supported by state Rep. Betsy Coffia, D-Traverse City, and state Sen. John DaMoose, R-Harbor Springs.

title: CHILD CARE: Grant to expand child care in Grand Traverse, Benzie counties | Betsy Coffia
